AdapterCapabilities.description:
What an adapter declares about itself. Unknown keys are carried as
declared.

source.description: Technology tag the adapter reports under.
source.title: Source

kinds.description: Asset kinds this source can position.
kinds.title: Kinds

frame.description: Frame of the measurements it sends.
frame.title: Frame

streaming.description: The adapter pushes its fixes instead of being polled.
streaming.title: Streaming

nominalAccuracy.description: Nominal horizontal accuracy of the installed source, used for a fix that reports none. Takes precedence over `accuracy_class`, and is required with the open-ended `coarse`.
nominalAccuracy.title: Nominalaccuracy

nominalVerticalAccuracy.description: Nominal one-sigma error of the height of the installed source, used for a fix that carries `z` without `verticalAccuracy`. Requires `z: true`.
nominalVerticalAccuracy.title: Nominalverticalaccuracy

discover.description: Serves GET /discover, the vendor device list.
discover.title: Discover

placement.description: Accepts a placement, for a synthetic source.
placement.title: Placement

reporting.description: How the source produces fixes. `on_request`: a fix at each poll. `periodic`: a fix at least every `reportingInterval`. `on_motion`: a fix whenever the device moves, and a communication at least every `reportingInterval` while it is still. Undeclared, the source counts as `periodic` without an interval, and its fixes are never current.
reporting.title: Reporting

reportingInterval.description: Longest time between two reports the source guarantees, transport included. Required with `periodic` and `on_motion`.
reportingInterval.title: Reportinginterval
